description: This file provides byte swapping functions and macros for handling endianness conversions, including implementations for 32-bit and 64-bit values, and defines for byte order detection.

methods.name: default_swab32
methods.description: Performs byte swapping for 32-bit unsigned integers using bitwise operations.

methods.name: default_bswap64
methods.description: Performs byte swapping for 64-bit unsigned integers using bitwise operations.

methods.name: get_be16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit big-endian value from a memory location.

methods.name: get_be32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit big-endian value from a memory location.

methods.name: get_be64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit big-endian value from a memory location.

methods.name: put_be32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value in big-endian format to a memory location.

methods.name: put_be64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit value in big-endian format to a memory location.
